children: Atoshi founder Leomars Liao will join the community live on X and Facebook at 8:00 PM Beijing Time on 30 September 2026 to announce the mainnet date and outline next steps for the project. The session gives ATOS holders a direct, scheduled update on when the network's mainnet is expected to go live, replacing an open-ended wait with a specific launch timeline communicated by the team itself.

The announcement converts an indefinite timeline into a dated launch window, which gives investors a concrete catalyst to plan around ahead of the network's debut. A stated mainnet date also creates a reference point for tracking whether subsequent milestones, such as testnet progress or deployment preparations, stay on schedule. The session reveals a schedule rather than executing the launch, so the mainnet still needs to ship as announced before the timeline translates into an operating network. The live format on X and Facebook allows the community to hear the date and next steps directly from the founder and raise questions in real time.
